meta.defaultTitle: Saint Vincent Studio · Independent Design & Manufacturing
meta.defaultDescription: An independent design and manufacturing studio making miniature worlds, modular models, lighting and objects designed to be kept.

home.selectDetailHint: Tap the numbered points to read the design notes.
home.processLede: A design is measured by how many times it was redrawn, not by how many days it took.
home.modularHeading: Start with one tile. Grow it your way.
home.modularHint: Pick a module, then tap a tile to place it. A first sketch of the configurator.

concept: A question and a sketch. What the object is for, and why someone would want to keep it.
design: Proportion, form, joinery. Every dimension is drawn before anything is made.
prototype: The first physical model, to test what a drawing cannot tell you.
refine: Tolerances corrected, proportions rebalanced, anything unnecessary removed.
manufacture: Made in the studio, with a controlled process for each part.
finish: Surfaces finished, each piece checked and packed by hand.
